title: Five new ItsyWeb identities
question: Which direction would you like to develop? Each changes the symbol, lettering and palette. These are concepts; the current website is unchanged.

options.label: Little Weaver
options.viewport: Large lockup with monochrome and small-size studies.
options.risk: A playful mascot can feel less technical.

options.label: Printer’s Device
options.viewport: Large lockup with monochrome and small-size studies.
options.risk: Could feel more like publishing than software.

options.label: Open Frame
options.viewport: Large lockup with monochrome and small-size studies.
options.risk: Needs a distinctive silhouette to avoid generic geometry.

options.label: Quickstroke
options.viewport: Large lockup with monochrome and small-size studies.
options.risk: The motion language may suggest a sports brand.
